parsed.explanation: Robust legal protections, GI anti-discrimination, self-determination and marriage are strong climate signals, not offsets; no trans criminalisation or universal facility exclusion appears. Recent equality-body reports of rising violence and intimidation, trans and gay men especially affected, physical-assault cases, dating-app ambushes and high harassment create real traveller-facing social risk. Recourse is partial: courts can recognise bias motives, but no hate-crime coding and many incidents go unreported. LGBT-wide figures are imperfect proxies and trans-specific rates unknown, so uncertainty remains. Exposure is private hostility with some functioning protection, not state-imposed outing, placing it in reduced but not clearly safe territory.
